Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Scotland players make their way out to the middle, followed by the Zimbabwe openers, Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine. Safyaan Sharif will start with the ball.
... Run Chase ...

Zimbabwe would be disappointed with the effort. They started well with the seamers doing a decent job and keeping things tight but they started to leak runs in the middle overs. Luke Jongwe did pick up two wickets but was slightly expensive. The spinners did a decent job and at one stage, it looked like they will restrict Scotland to around 150 but 30 runs in the last over from Richard Ngarava has given them a steep target to chase. Will they be able to chase it down? We will find out as the run chase begins in a while.

Scotland did not start off too well as they lost Kyle Coetzer early but George Munsey looked good and played a fine hand of 54. Oliver Hairs did not last long while Munsey departed after scoring his fifty. There could have been a collapse but Richie Berrington and Calum MacLeod calmed things and took it slow before they both upped the ante. Berrington fell but a superb last over for them has given them a very good score on the board.

A very good last over for Scotland has propelled their score to 177! It is a very good score on this wicket and they will be very pleased with the effort. It was a fantastic batting effort and now they will hope that their bowlers can do the job. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, would be disappointed as that last over from Richard Ngarava has put them on the back foot now.
Low full toss, on off. Michael Leask pushes it away for one. 30 runs from that over! Scotland end at 177 for 4!
Length ball, on off. Michael Leask gets the leading edge over covers for a couple.
Short of a length, outside off. Punched past covers for a couple.
NO BALL AND SIX! Length ball, wide outside off. Michael Leask shuffles across and heaves it over the square leg fence. No ball called as Richard Ngarava has overstepped again. Free Hit coming up.
SIX! Smoked all the way! Length ball, on middle and leg. Michael Leask whips it all the way over the square leg fence.
Yorker, on leg. Calum MacLeod gets hit on the pads and they get a leg bye.
NO BALL AND FOUR! Length ball, outside off. Calum MacLeod hits it over the short third man fielder for a boundary. No ball called as Richard Ngarava has overstepped. Free Hit coming up.
SIX! All the way! A low full toss, outside off. Calum MacLeod hits it all the way over the mid-wicket fence.
OUT! TAKEN! Straight to the man! A low full toss, outside off. Richie Berrington carves it straight to Sean Williams at deep point.

Short of a length, on off. Pulled to long on for one.
SIX! That is a cracking shot! Length ball, outside off. Richie Berrington lifts it over covers for a maximum.
Full ball, outside off. Richie Berrington hits it back to the bowler.

Shorter ball, around off. Slapped to covers for one.
On a length, down the leg side. Pulled to fine leg for a couple.
Back of a length, around off. Calum MacLeod cuts it to deep point for one.
Short ball, around leg. Left alone.
Full ball, on leg. Richie Berrington clips it to fine leg for one.
Short of a length, around leg. Richie Berrington comes down the track but misses the heave.

Short ball, outside off. Calum MacLeod misses the pull.
Short of a length, around off. Worked down to third man for one.

Shortish ball outside off, MacLeod guides it to third man for a single.
Tossed up on off, Berrington pushes it to point.
FOUR! Excellent shot from Richie Berrington! Full outside off, Berrington lifts it over cover for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Berrington heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball outside off, Calum cuts it to deep point for a single.
Flighted on the pads, MacLeod looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up on middle, MacLeod reverse-paddles it to third man for a couple.
On off, pushed to the off side.
Tossed up on off, MacLeod looks to defend but it goes off the inner half to short fine leg. A single taken.

DROPPED! Another one goes down! Zimbabwe are not helping themselves! Tossed up on middle, Berrington looks to go over long on but does not time it well. It goes to long on where the fielder puts it down. A single taken.
On middle, MacLeod sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
DROPPED! A sitter put down! Flatter ball around off, Berrington punches it to cover where the fielder fails to hold onto the catch. A single taken as it goes to the man in the deep.

Good-length ball outside off, Richie plays it to point.

Flighted ball outside off, MacLeod looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Floated ball on off, MacLeod defends it to cover.

Just a single as this is pushed to long off.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! What an over this was! Another reverse sweep and another boundary. This time, George Munsey hits it past the deep point fielder for a boundary.
SIX! All the way! This is brilliant batting. Full ball, on off. George Munsey plays the reverse sweep over the point fence.
FOUR! He connects this time! Full ball, on off. George Munsey reverse-sweeps it to the point fence.
Tossed up, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, on off. George Munsey misses the reverse sweep and gets hit on the pads.
Flatter ball, around off. George Munsey misses the reverse sweep.
Wesley Madhevere comes into the attack.
FOUR! Smacked! Short of a length, outside off. Hairs smacks it past mid on for a boundary.
DROPPED! Length ball, on off. Hairs looks to heave it but gets the top edge. The ball goes towards third man. The fielder runs in and dives but drops it. Two taken.
Short ball, outside off. Cut away past covers for one.
Short of a length, outside off. George Munsey misses the cut.
Shorter ball, outside off. Chopped to covers.
Full ball, outside off. Pushed to mid off for one.

SIX! OH MY WORD! This is a massive over for Scotland! Full ball, on off. George Munsey hits it straight back over the bowler's head. 22 from the over. That ends the Powerplay and Scotland are 50 for 1.
Short ball, around leg. George Munsey misses the pull.
SIX! That is clobbered! On a length, on off. George Munsey clears his front leg and heaves it straight back over the bowler.
Full ball, way outside off. Left alone. Wide called again.
Back of a length, around off. Pushed back to the bowler.

Full ball, way outside off. Left alone. Wided.
Good-length ball on the pads, Munsey flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Lovely stroke from Munsey! He is looking good! Back of a length ball on off, Munsey plays it through extra cover for a boundary.
EDGED AND FOUR! Munsey gets away with it! Short ball around middle, Munsey looks to pull but it goes off the top edge and it flies over the keeper's head for a boundary.
On off, pushed to the cover region.

Short ball outside off, Munsey sways away from it.
Oliver Hairs walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Well, this was coming, given the way Coetzer was swinging his bat on the last few balls. He was looking uncomfortable at the crease and he perishes. Short ball around off, Coetzer looks to pull but it goes off the top edge and goes behind. Chakabva settles himself under it and takes it.

Commentary.Commentary: Another play and miss! Short and outside off, Coetzer looks to pull but misses.
SWING AND A MISS! Good-length ball outside off. Coetzer sets himself up to swing it away but fails to get anything on it.
FOUR! Heaved away! Length ball on middle, Coetzer heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good-length ball outside off, Coetzer pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Cut away! Good-length ball outside off, Munsey cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
FOUR! There it is, the first boundary of the game! Fullish ball on off, Munsey lifts it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

Good-length ball outside off, Munsey looks to smack it over the off side but misses.

Good-length ball on off, Kyle defends it to cover-point. Excellent over from Ngarava.
On a length outside off, punched to cover off the back foot.
Play and a miss! Good length outside off, Coetzer stands tall and looks to punch it but fails to get any bat on it.

Good-length ball on off, Coetzer looks to flick but it goes off the pads to the off side. A leg bye taken.

Toss - The news from the middle is that Scotland have won the toss and they will bat first!
Update 1:48 pm Local (12:38 pm GMT) - We have good news! Live visuals show that the rain has stopped and the covers are coming off. We should get some more good news soon.

Update 1:33 pm Local (12:33 pm GMT) - Well, we should have had the toss by now but the latest news is that the toss has been delayed due to rain. We hope that the rain is not too heavy and we get this decider started soon.

Sean Williams was the star for Zimbabwe in the second game! If not for him, Zimbabwe would have posted a low score and this game might not have been the decider. But here they are now because of Williams and now the visitors would look to be clinical and take the series. Toss and teams coming up in a bit.

Richie Berrington has been in good form for Scotland in this series. He has looked assured at the crease and is looking in top form at the moment. He though needs support from the other end if Scotland have to take the series. They need to become consistent and they would want to take the confidence into the T20 World Cup.

Hello and a warm welcome to the final T20I between Scotland and Zimbabwe. It is the decider and it has been an interesting series so far. Scotland won the first game quite convincingly but Zimbabwe bounced back strongly in the second to take the series to the decider. Both teams are strong and Scotland would look to win it and gain some momentum before the T20 World Cup. What will happen?
